summary: usb-storage is blocked from loading on node1 now and after reboot. The node restarted successfully, returned healthy with a changed boot ID, and a post-reboot load attempt was denied.
actions_performed: Created /etc/modprobe.d/disable-usb-storage.conf with blacklist and install-denial rules.
Verified usb_storage was absent and explicit loading failed.
Safely rebooted node1 and verified post-restart health and persistence.

evidence.summary: modprobe resolved usb-storage to /bin/false; an explicit load attempt exited 1 and the module remained absent.

evidence.requirement: Prevent usb-storage from loading after reboot
evidence.summary: The initramfs was rebuilt; after reboot the policy remained present, explicit loading failed, and usb_storage remained absent.

Baseline boot ID was 4b7ded33-b5e2-42c9-b7f2-bd671942a82d; restart was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to 74bab2c7-108d-4209-bee0-b98b16ca6aad; system state and root filesystem recovered, and the blacklist remained effective.
